items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I think that was on the side of the tape. It didn't work. Who was the first trumpet with Celestan? The one, uh, was Herman Franklin that I remember when I was working with.

ctx.x: Well the Celestan band had a lot of guys in it then or was it a small band?
No, Celestan was all, I can tell you at that time there were three big bands, Celestan, Sidney Desbenes, Sonny South, Pierron, all the guys from 10 to 11 there. Yeah, yeah.
Did you ever play with, we talked to all of the losers in the last week or so, Peter Lacazze, did you ever play with him?
